scope: Q1 block-loop unroll by two versus retained sign-mask build and matched mx Vulkan; twelve fixed calls, not final qualification.
decision: Keep the sign-mask implementation. Unroll-by-two adds no measured prefill benefit and loses decode in all four matched observations. No full-depth qualification of the scratch trial is needed.
change: Only Q1 integer two-row block loop is unrolled by two. Per-lane block order, dots, FMA, tail guards and range repair are unchanged.

workload.timing_boundary: Existing pinned harness; P128/G256, full PP/TG warmups, one final prompt head. Native synchronization boundaries retained.
